editions.text:
The day added up to a quieter one than the week before: 190 feeder visits against a seven-day average of 295.9, and 19 species against an average of 20.4. Heard detections came to 415, close to the average of 428.6. Tufted Titmouse led the visits with 45, and House Finch and Eastern Towhee each had 74 detections.

Every one of the 14 species recorded on all seven days of the past week was recorded again today, so the regulars held. Nothing was heard or seen here for the first time, and no notable records were logged. Several species from earlier in the week, including Canada Goose and American Kestrel, were not recorded today.

The audio source was switched to the pi-mic (movo-dom1) at 07:14 and changed several times again from 18:32 onward. Detections after each change come from the source then active, so the heard counts for this day mix sources.
